name: Adimanebart IV
sort_evidence: Adimanebart is the INN for ARGX-119, a MuSK agonist antibody with a Phase 3 CMS trial not yet recruiting (NCT07746089); it is the clearer-named of two population rows for this molecule (https://accp1.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1002/jcph.70208).
